title: prf with eval at create, then get with first and second salts

unsafe.definition: PRF outputs or the hmac-secret seed exposed anywhere except the get result (e.g. in the page-visible create result when the provider does not support eval at create)

note: L3 §10.1.4: eval is allowed at registration (results optional, enabled reported); at authentication results.first and results.second are returned for two salts.
